description: Opening the Inventory Value report for the first time in a browser shows every column already switched on, including Margin and Total Sell. Those two are meant to start hidden.
steps: Open a browser window that has never opened this report before — a private window works.
Sign in and open Reports, then Inventory Value.

Read the column headings across the top of the table. No test data needs setting up; this was seen with Locations Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and Staging Lethbridge - 4310 and the date range This Month.
current:
On a genuine first visit the headings read: Part #, Description, Category, Vendor, Location, Qty, Unit Cost, Unit Sell, Margin, Margin %, Total Sell, Total Cost. Margin and Total Sell are both on.

The control itself works — switching Margin off hides it and switching it back on restores it in the right place. Only the starting state is wrong.
expected: On a first visit the report opens with Margin and Total Sell hidden, and the user turns them on from the column-selection control if they want them.
source: On first visit, the visible columns are: Part #, Description, Category, Vendor, Qty on Hand, Unit Cost, Unit Sell, Margin %, and Total Cost.
The Margin and Total Sell columns are hidden by default and can be turned on from the column-selection control (Story 8).
Every other column is available in the control; Margin and Total Sell are off by default, the rest on by default (S3-R12).
